data.name: Cold Blast
data.description: As a standard action, you can unleash a blast of freezing cold. This blast deals 1d6+%1 points of cold damage to all creatures within 5 feet of you and staggers them for 1 round. A successful Reflex save DC %2 negates the staggered effect and halves the damage. You can use this ability %3 times per day.|WaterSchoolLVL/2|WaterSchoolLVL/2+10+INT|WaterColdBlastTimes
